justification: Both are low-relief stone surfaces with human figures and small rectangular sign-like panels, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. B depicts a specific narrative siege scene — archers on a wheeled ram engine attacking a crenellated, arched city wall — while A shows a single frontal standing figure with headdress flanked by vertical columns of blocky glyph-like signs, with no architecture, no weapons and no action; the compositional logic (narrative left-to-right assault vs. static central icon with text columns) is entirely different.
